title: Q-LAYER-child-reporting: A child system reports its liveness to its parent
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:instances/ultrastable/child-link.json
**Status:** open

Layers (doctrine/pilot-model.json `layers`): the bootstrapper now records parent and level. Build the reporting path: the child's /health metrics are read by the parent's http probe, and a silent child breaches M-parent-link. Record the first working link in instances/ultrastable/child-link.json.
